records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: •Net sales were $1,024.4 million, a decrease of 12.4%

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: The backlog of orders at December 31, 2020 was $360.5 million compared to $263.7 million at December 31, 2019, an increase of $96.8 million or 36.7%.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: The increase in the backlog of orders was due to an increase in domestic backlog of $86.2 million or 44.3% and an increase in international backlog of $10.6 million or 15.4%.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: The purchase price was $13.8 million, after adjustments, and was paid in cash.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: •Income from operations increased $17.9 million to $43.0 million
